title: EverList SLA-lite (Partner Tier)
measurement: Monthly, measured at /api/health and /search on the production endpoint; excludes scheduled maintenance announced >= 48h in advance and force-majeure events (AGB v2.1 s.8(2)).

P1.definition: Public booking or escrow-status surface unavailable or materially wrong

credits: None in this lite tier: SLA-lite is a target commitment, not a money-back SLA. Credit-backed SLAs are a Tier-2 contract item.
honesty_note: EverList is a solo-founder pre-revenue service; this SLA states targets honestly instead of promising penalties it cannot honor. Enterprise partners get a negotiated SLA at Tier 2/3.
